camps.name: Arcadia Nature Camp
camps.description_short: A Mass Audubon nature day camp for ages 5–15 at Arcadia Wildlife Sanctuary in Easthampton, Monday to Friday, 9 am to 3 pm. Campers hike, play games, make crafts and explore forests, meadows, streams and vernal pools, with specialty weeks for nature photography and environmental leadership.

camps.description_short: An overnight camp for girls finishing 1st through 9th grade on Lake Ashmere in the Berkshires. Over 30 activities, from waterskiing and tennis to theater, gymnastics and pottery, with a 1:3 counselor to camper ratio and an emphasis on skill building over competition.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Campers swim in Lake Ashmere and in two heated pools. The waterfront offers waterskiing, wakeboarding, sailing, paddleboarding, canoeing, kayaking and fishing.

camps.name: Camp Farley Day Camp
camps.description_short: Weekday day camp in Mashpee on Cape Cod for ages 6 to 15, with swimming, boating, archery, arts and crafts, nature and sports. Sprouts, for ages 4 and 5, runs full or half days. Eight weekly sessions in summer 2027.
camps.refund_policy_summary: $100 deposit per camper is non-refundable and non-transferable. Cancel by March 31, 2027: full refund minus the deposit and a $25 admin fee. April 1 to May 31, 2027: camp keeps the deposit plus 25% of tuition. June 1, 2027 or later: no refund. Prorated refunds for acute medical illness or injury with a doctor's note, at the camp's discretion. No refunds for early departures or late arrivals. Any balance is charged automatically on June 1, 2027.

camps.name: Discovery Adventures
camps.description_short: Week-long themed history day programs at Old Sturbridge Village, a living history museum. In summer, kids ages 6 to 17 spend 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. in 19th-century costume, cooking over the open hearth, doing farm chores, making crafts and working with the Village's costumed historians. Groups are by age, with themes that change each week.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Refunds are available up to two weeks before your week's program starts. You can switch weeks if there is space in your child's age group; a change fee applies.

camps.name: EcoTarium Summer Discovery Camp and Vacation Week Camp
camps.description_short: Week-long themed science and nature day camps at the EcoTarium museum in Worcester for ages 5-12, run 9 am-4 pm, Monday-Friday. Campers are grouped by age. There is also a Counselor-in-Training program for ages 13-15.
camps.refund_policy_summary: Deposits and camp fees are nonrefundable and nontransferable. Fees minus the $75 deposit can be refunded only if you cancel in writing by May 1 for summer camp, or four weeks before a vacation week camp. Later refunds are considered only for medical or emergency reasons.
camps.special_needs_notes: The camp works with children who have school aides, IEPs or BIPs; a child's aide is welcome at camp after CORI/SORI checks. Give the Camp Director at least three weeks' notice of any accommodation, assistive device or major allergy. All food must be peanut and tree nut free, and staff are trained for allergy emergencies.

camps.name: Hitchcock Center Nature Summer Camp
camps.description_short: An outdoor nature day camp at the Hitchcock Center for the Environment in Amherst. Kids do hikes, animal observation, science and crafts. Nature Camp runs 8:45 AM to 3:00 PM for kids entering grades K to 6. Chickadee Camp is a half-day program (8:45 AM to 1:00 PM) for rising kindergartners. The Leadership Training Camp is for grades 7 to 9.
activities: Mud and dirt play, slime making
Caving, hikes and overnight camping (Leadership Training Camp)
camps.refund_policy_summary: You can cancel yourself through your Active account. More than 90 days before your session starts: full refund minus a 6% platform fee. 30–90 days before: refund minus the $150 deposit. Less than 30 days before: no refund, unless the program is full and your spot gets filled, in which case you may get 50% back. There are no refunds for absences, sick days or vacations. Exceptions are made only for a health emergency, documented by a physician, that keeps the child out for the whole session.
camps.special_needs_notes: The camp welcomes campers with social, emotional, physical, cognitive or behavioral challenges. If a child has a 1:1 aide at school, a 1:1 must also be provided at camp (a parent or guardian can do this). Campers must be able to move around on uneven terrain. Families should contact the Camp Director before enrolling to talk through accommodations. If needs are not disclosed, the child may be dismissed without a refund. Staff are trained to give EpiPens, and there is an individual health plan process for life-threatening allergies.
camps.swim_waterfront_notes: No swimming program is mentioned. Campers bring a swimsuit and towel for sprinkler play only.

camps.swim_waterfront_notes: Sailing is on open water at two sites. Polpis Harbor is a protected, calm harbor used for younger and beginner sailors. Jetties Beach on Nantucket Sound has open-water sailing for older and more experienced sailors. The page does not mention a swim test or swim requirements.

camps.name: Nantucket Nature Bound Program (Teen Naturalist Leadership Program)
camps.description_short: A set of week-long afternoon nature programs (1:15-4:15pm) for teens aged 13-17, run by the Maria Mitchell Association on Nantucket. Each week has its own theme, such as coastal ecology, marine and land ecology, cross-island hikes, or behind-the-scenes work at the museum and aquarium.
camps.refund_policy_summary: MMA may cancel a camper's spot without a refund if the medical and registration forms are not received at least two weeks before the session starts. The page gives no general refund policy.
